REQUIREMENTS_ANALYSIS.PROJECT_GOAL: Provide the MAG8000-LTE 4G communication module for MAG8000 Transmitter with the functionality specified in feature specification baseline 4.

SYSTEM_INTERACTION.PURPOSE: Mag8000 web APP will trigger GET_PARAMETER command in order to get all needed parameter.
The module will send the alarms to MQTT Broker in case errors are detected with the time stamp. Refer to chapter "Real time alarm message format." of document MQTT Interface .
Clock synchronization of the module will be done through synchronisation in UNIX-UTC timing provided by thingstream server. . This clock will be synchronized regularly.

SOURCE_REQUIREMENT.CHAPTER_NAME: The measurement data collected from the host device will be saved in csv format....
SOURCE_REQUIREMENT.REQIF_TEXT: The measurement data collected from the host device will be saved in csv format. The filename of the csv file will be composed of Prefix_[identifier]_[timestamp].csv Prefix: ordinary text strings, configurable by a parameter; Timestamp: YYYYMMDD_HHmm; Identifier: read from the modbus register of the host device -> " MeterSerialNo" (248)

SOURCE_REQUIREMENT.CHAPTER_NAME: The measurement data read from the host device (TRN) will be compiled in the csv...
SOURCE_REQUIREMENT.REQIF_TEXT: The measurement data read from the host device (TRN) will be compiled in the csv file. The format of the measurement data stored in the csv file will be : [timestamp];[FL];[FL unit];[TOT1];[TOT2];[TOT3];[TOT unit];[V1];[V2];[BT];[AL] timestamp = YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM FL value = Flow rate value FL unit = unit of Flow rate TOT1 = Totalizer 1 value TOT2 = Totalizer 2 value TOT3 = Totalizer 3 value TOT unit = Totalizer unit V1 = the converted process value from voltage input 1 V2 = the converted process value from voltage input 2 BT = remaining battery capacity (integer value from 0 to 100, i.e. BT%), Transmitter battery capacity wil be used (3030). AL = alarms in decimal value (host device alarm) For example, the measurement data stored in the csv file shall as below 2018-01-01 05:02;0.000;m3/h;1.199;0.732;1.199;m3;0.0;0.0;96;5176 2018-01-01 05:03;0.000;m3/h;1.199;0.732;1.199;m3;0.0;0.0;96;5176 2018-01-01 05:04;0.000;m3/h;1.199;0.732;1.199;m3;0.0;0.0;96;5176
